args.content:
import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1"
response = urllib.request.urlopen(url)
data = json.loads(response.read())
title = data["title"]

with open("todo.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(title)
